scenario: Verify that the login page is accessible to unauthenticated users.
assertions: Assert 200 OK status code. Assert content type is HTML.

scenario: Verify that the registration page is accessible to unauthenticated users.
assertions: Assert 200 OK status code. Assert content type is HTML.

scenario: Verify successful user registration with valid credentials.
assertions: Assert 302 Found status code. Assert 'Location' header is '/login'. Assert success flash attribute is set (implicitly via redirect).

scenario: Verify user registration fails with an existing username.
assertions: Assert 302 Found status code. Assert 'Location' header is '/register'. Assert error flash attribute is set (implicitly via redirect) with a message indicating the username already exists.

scenario: Verify user registration fails with a missing username parameter.
assertions: Assert 400 Bad Request status code (due to @RequestParam).

scenario: Verify user registration fails with a missing password parameter.
assertions: Assert 400 Bad Request status code (due to @RequestParam).

scenario: Verify user registration fails with empty username and password.
assertions: Assert 302 Found status code. Assert 'Location' header is '/register'. Assert error flash attribute is set (implicitly via redirect) with an appropriate validation message (assuming UserService handles this).

scenario: Security: Attempt to register with potential SQL injection in username.
assertions: Assert 302 Found status code. Assert 'Location' header is '/register' or '/login' based on UserService behavior. Verify no unexpected server errors or data corruption.

scenario: Security: Attempt to register with potential XSS in username.
assertions: Assert 302 Found status code. Assert 'Location' header is '/register' or '/login'. Verify the input is sanitized or rejected, and no script execution occurs on subsequent page loads.

scenario: Verify access to the home page for an unauthenticated user.
assertions: Assert 200 OK status code. Assert content type is HTML. Verify no username is displayed.

scenario: Verify access to the home page for an authenticated user.
assertions: Assert 200 OK status code. Assert content type is HTML. Verify the authenticated username is displayed in the response.

scenario: Security: Verify home page access with an invalid or expired authentication token.
assertions: Assert 302 Found status code (redirect to login) or 401 Unauthorized/403 Forbidden, depending on Spring Security configuration. If redirected, assert 'Location' header points to login.
